title: fremontia californica subsp. obispoensis
intro: Fremontia californica subsp. obispoensis, commonly known as Obispo fremontia or yellow fremontia, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae) that is native to the coastal mountains of central California. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, wounds, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting tissue repair. The therapeutic actions of Fremontia californica subsp. obispoensis include its antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its use in wound healing and skin care. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified through various studies.
